lines.value: A lookup of the validity and status of sanitary registrations issued by Invima, with basic, advanced and InvimÁgil search.

lines.label: Authorisation

source.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos

lines.value: The registro sanitario is a public document issued by Invima or a delegated authority that entitles a person or company to produce, market, import or export a medicine.

lines.label: Scheme

source.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos

lines.value: IUM (Identificador Único de Medicamento), Resolución 3311 de 2018

lines.label: Rule

source.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos

lines.value: Invima assigns one IUM to each commercial presentation, built in three linked levels (common description, commercial medicine, commercial presentation) without dots, hyphens, accents or spaces; printing the IUM on labels and packaging is not required.
